description: BAY CITY, Mich. (Aug. 25, 2026) — Hours after yesterday’s U.S. Supreme Court ruling on mail-in ballots, Sen. Chedrick Greene hosted a Voter Rights Town Hall in Bay City for the community to engage in honest dialogue around Michigan’s election system. Sen. Greene was joined by Aghogho Edevbie, Michigan’s Deputy Secretary of State, to unpack how elections work, address any concerns and misinformation, and connect attendees to civic resources.…
